name: HCTF Community Grants
summary: Small matched grants for organisations and individuals to run hands-on, volunteer-based conservation projects in British Columbia, up to $10,000 in any one year.
reporting: A report on the activities carried out is required once the project is completed, and a progress report goes with any new application to continue it.

applicant_types.quote: Community Grants provide funding to organizations and individuals who need financial help to implement a conservation project.

geography.quote: Since 1974, the Province of BC and the Habitat Conservation Trust Foundation have provided approximately $150,000 each year to help implement on-the-ground conservation work

access.quote: Complete and submit your application online using the Survey Apply system.

window.quote: Intake opens January 15 Online application submission January-February (see the Apply tab for more info). Application deadline is February 28 at 4:30pm (PT)

amount.quote: Eligible expenses up to $10,000 in any one year.

co_finance_required.quote: You must match the requested funds by contributing a combination of volunteer labour (credited at $20 per hour), materials, or other allowable donations.

reporting.quote: Once your Community Grant project has been completed, a report is required which details the activities that were conducted.
